_meta.description: Curated, reproducible seed of historical work-slug renames (the data-side of a 301 redirect). Each entry records a 1:1 rename where the OLD slug was retired and its text now serves under the NEW slug. build_id_registry.py replays these against the persistent ledger data/work_ids.json: the work keeps its opaque ogc id and the old slug is appended to that id's former_slugs, so a citation of the old slug still resolves to the same work. This file is the single source of truth for renames; rename_work.py appends to it and re-runs the builder. Only clean 1:1 renames belong here. Catch-all dissolves (one slug fanned out into many per-author works, e.g. the SVF1/SVF3 Arnim volumes) are NOT renames: the retired catch-all has no single successor, so its id is tombstoned by the builder rather than redirected.

schema.from: retired (old) work slug, no longer served
schema.source: evidence / script or audit trail that performed the rename
